[NCBK.2.1] Receives every observable event the engine produces, in `seq` order,
with engine-clock timestamps. The stream is the foundation for replay,
debugging, and durable recording (LFST): a single stream subscriber can
reconstruct the engine's full activity — fact lifecycle, rule firing, every
action verb — without registering any typed verb callback below.

The callback type is `ds_stream_cb_t`, its payload `ds_stream_ev_t`, and it is registered by `ds_engine_set_stream_callback` — all declared in `runtime/include/libds.h`.
